title: finding(plugin-calendar): a week or day view RESIZE of an overnight event anchors on the clipped piece, so the top handle drops the hours past midnight and the bottom handle moves the start to midnight
body:
Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat #1 (`session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11057 (`Fixes #11037`). The dev measured this as an out-of-scope finding: objectui#11037 fixed the MOVE branch and excluded resize by claim. ⛔ Not graded or routed here; that is triage's.

## What goes wrong (measured once, a throwaway jsdom probe at PR objectui#11057's head `5ce5efca2`)

Week view, one event from 2026-01-12 22:00 to 2026-01-13 02:00 (UTC). It is drawn as two pieces, clipped at midnight.
- **The top resize handle of its first piece, dragged to 21:00**, hands `onEventDrop` 2026-01-12 21:00 → 2026-01-13 **00:00**. The two hours past midnight are lost. `plugin-calendar`'s README says a top resize preserves the end.
- **The bottom resize handle of its second piece, dragged to 03:00**, hands 2026-01-13 **00:00** → 03:00. The start moved to midnight.

`ObjectCalendar`'s default drop handler writes what it is handed, so both are stored.

## Cause (read at source)

In `packages/plugin-calendar/src/CalendarView.tsx`'s time grid, `resize-top` anchors on the grabbed piece's clipped `endMin` (1440), and `resize-bottom` anchors on its clipped `startMin` (0), both on the grabbed day. It is the same class as objectui#11037, whose move now reads the true event from the piece model (`Entry` carries it beside the clipped bounds).

## Direction (for triage to confirm)

A resize keeps the event's other edge where it truly is:
- the top handle changes only the start;
- the bottom handle changes only the end.

Both are read from the true event, as PR objectui#11057 does for the move. Pins: both handles on both pieces of an overnight event, plus a same-day control. If the fix touches instants, it follows objectui#10866's reading (a `datetime` keeps its instant).

Dedupe words: week view resize overnight event truncated, time grid resize-top anchorEndMin clipped piece, calendar resize handle loses end past midnight.
